newsitem.title: USA: Mobil launches synthetic diesel lubricant.
newsitem.headline: Mobil launches synthetic diesel lubricant.

text.p: Mobil Corp said Thursday that it has introduced a low-chlorine, zinc-free synthetic lubricant for medium- and high-speed diesel engines in the marine lubricant market.

The company also said that Detroit Diesel Corp conducted extensive field tests of the synthetic lubricant in its DDC 149 Series engines and found that it demonstrated the ability to reduce engine wear and extend oil drain intervals, despite severe operating conditions.
Mobil said that Mobilgard 1 SHC has also been tested in passenger ferry boat engines in Europe with positive results.
